I had the idea of a trigger which could be used with a bomb and attached to
the wiring in the floor of a room. Ideally with the power to the room off.
Then if someone flips on the APC in the room, it goes kablooey.

I like this idea, would certainly give a little more spice to the life of any 
maintenance workers!
That sound good! People get angry when the power is off, wait till they are ghosts/gibs!
